# HEPH-VAL-422

**Validation failed**

| | |
| --- | --- |
| HTTP status | `422` |
| Area | `VAL` |
| Problem `type` | `https://heph.neoforgelabs.tech/errors/HEPH-VAL-422` |

## What the caller sees

This is the default `detail` sent in the problem+json response, verbatim:

The request failed validation. Each offending field and the rule it broke is listed under errors.

## What to do as a developer

Guidance for the engineer who hit this code. It is non-normative: it is never
sent on the wire and does not constrain an implementation. Wire behaviour is
defined only by `spec/heph-spec.md` and the conformance vectors.

The request parsed but broke a validation rule, or a JSON document could not be canonicalised (for example an integer literal above 2\^53-1, a duplicate member name or nesting deeper than 128). Fix the offending field in the request; the response lists each field and the rule it broke under errors. When your own handler rejects input, return this code with one entry per field rather than inventing a new code. It is also what signing a webhook with an unusable secret returns, which is a configuration fault, so fix the secret.
